infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Seivio to access the microphone for voice search and voice introductions.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow Seivio to access your location for city and area discovery.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Seivio to access your photos to update your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Seivio to access the camera to take a profile picture.
